tour.title: Start At The Entry Points
tour.description: Begin with the backend entry point and the two client bootstraps. These files show how Trenfy exposes its API, mounts the admin web UI, and initializes the white-label mobile app.
tour.languageLesson: Notice the split between Python server startup and TypeScript app bootstrap files.

tour.title: Trace The API Surface
tour.description: Follow the FastAPI surface from the main app into route modules and request contracts. This is where trend data becomes HTTP resources for the clients.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI leans on typed request and response models to keep endpoints predictable.

tour.title: Understand Orchestration And Domain Logic
tour.description: The workflow and shared-agent modules coordinate trend ingestion, scheduling, and common domain structures. Reading these files explains how raw source data becomes normalized trend records.
tour.languageLesson: Python workflow modules often centralize sequencing while data models keep the state shape explicit.

tour.title: Inspect External Integrations
tour.description: These utilities connect Trenfy to upstream sources and supporting services such as OpenAI, YouTube, X, translation, and NocoDB. They form the boundary between internal workflows and external APIs.
tour.languageLesson: Adapter-style modules isolate API details so workflow code can stay focused on business logic.

tour.title: Walk The Web Admin Experience
tour.description: The React admin UI is organized around pages, reusable components, and API wrappers. This step shows how the web app renders trend management screens and talks back to the FastAPI backend.
tour.languageLesson: Vite React apps usually separate route-level pages from shared UI and HTTP client modules.

tour.title: Walk The Mobile White-Label Experience
tour.description: The React Native app packages a parallel client experience with its own screens, components, seeded content, and theme tokens. It is the quickest way to understand how Trenfy can be repackaged for branded distribution.
tour.languageLesson: React Native combines component structure with design tokens so brand changes stay centralized.

tour.title: Finish With Validation And Operations
tour.description: Tests, configuration, and deployment files close the loop by defining environment wiring and expected behavior. This step is useful once you understand the product flow and want to verify or ship changes.
tour.languageLesson: Strong projects make operational setup and automated validation readable alongside the source code.
